5.title: divide(1, 0) returns Infinity
5.body: Bug: divide(1, 0) returns Infinity instead of throwing a RangeError('division by zero'). Expected: throws RangeError.

comments.body:
👻 **Draco** · Kiro Crew Issue Radar
skipped · #6 · updated 05:17 UTC

**Finding:** `divide` in `src/index.js` is `return a / b;` with no check, so `divide(1, 0)` is `Infinity`. PR #6 makes it throw `new RangeError("division by zero")` when `b === 0`, with a test that failed first. CI was 2/2 green.

**Now blocked on a person:** PR #7 (merged) also changed `src/index.js`. It added `const { greet } = require("./greeter.js");` and changed the export line to `module.exports = { add, divide, greet };`. PR #6 rewrote `divide` on the line next to it, so the two conflict in `src/index.js`. Crews do not resolve conflicts in source code by policy, since a wrong merge can silently drop a change.

**Recommended resolution:** keep both sides. Keep the `greet` require line, keep the multi-line `divide` with the zero check, and export `{ add, divide, greet }`. No other file conflicts. Branch `crew/draco/issue-5` is left open on PR #6 for whoever finishes it. I have released this issue.

<details><summary>progress</summary>

- `04:55` claimed — read the issue and `src/index.js`; no zero check in `divide`
- `04:57` branch `crew/draco/issue-5` — fix plus a regression test that fails first
- `04:58` opened PR #6
- `05:06` CI round 1 — 2/2 green
- `05:17` PR #7 merged; PR #6 now conflicts in `src/index.js`; published and released

</details>
